CMOS DCVSL two-bit equality comparator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
V0 a0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 50n 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
V1 a1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 100n 100p 100p 99.9n 200n)
V2 b0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 200n 100p 100p 199.9n 400n)
V3 b1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 400n 100p 100p 399.9n 800n)
XDUT vdd 0 eq ne a0 a1 b0 b1 astra_051_cmos_dcvsl_word_equality
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec s0eq range 3.2 3.4 unit=V

.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 800n
meas tran s0eq FIND v(eq) AT=30n
meas tran s0ne FIND v(ne) AT=30n
